Mexican Turkey Meat Loaf
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 pound ground turkey
1 (15 oz.) can tomato sauce
1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips
1/4 cup chopped onion
2 tablespoons chopped green pepper
1 packet taco seasoning mix

Preparation

1 Combine ingredients, reserving 1 cup tomato sauce. Spoon mixture into 9 x 5 loaf pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes. Heat reserved sauce and serve with meat loaf. 6 servings at 290 calories.

About


Serve with fresh green beans and baked potato. Substitute fresh salsa purchased or homemade for tomato sauce.
